name: duohaunt
title: duohaunt
blurb: norvid-studies.bsky.social wanted "the irreversible duolingo anki bot that follows you around harassing you in public," riffing on croissanthology.com's cursed idea. build your own deck, review it, and if you let cards go overdue your shame tier climbs on a public wall that keeps escalating whether you show up or not — posting the confession to bluesky is always your own one tap, never done behind your back.
